propositions: Dependabot PRs #123 and #124 are open on GitHub but cannot merge; they must be re-landed as three independent Gerrit changes and the PRs closed by hand.

PR #123 bumps actions/setup-python from v6 to v7 (with new SHA) across 13 workflow files and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish; these changes must be applied byte-identical via gh pr diff and include allowlist echo line updates.

PR #124 bumps mcp from 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major version) and ruff from 0.15.22 to 0.16.1; the mcp major risks breaking rebar-mcp's imports (mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP, mcp.server.auth APIs, mcp.server.transport_security, mcp.types.ToolAnnotations) and must be validated against the full test suite or deferred to a follow-up ticket.
A P0 blocking issue: pip-audit fails on click 8.2.1 (PYSEC-2026-2132 command injection); click >=8.3.3 must land first as Change 0 to unblock all other changes.

Change B must either (path 1) land mcp 2.0 with all test/lint/typecheck green plus updates to .github/workflows/_optionality.yml constraint and ADR 0050 documentation, or (path 2) retain mcp <2 with ruff bump only and defer mcp v2 migration to a discovered_from-linked follow-up ticket.
After each Gerrit change merges, the corresponding GitHub PR must be closed with a comment naming the Gerrit change URL and noting GitHub is a read-only mirror.
